choice:11:1:2.male: Rolan and I will hold this point.
choice:11:1:2.female: Rolan and I will hold this point.

narration:0:1710828101:1.text: Meanwhile, Gwyneth arrives at the central plaza...

say:3:1710828202:1.text: Thank goodness you're here, Captain! The situation's critical!
say:3:1710828202:1.source_cn: 队长！您来了！太好了！报告队长，情况有些糟糕……

say:4:1710828203:1.text: Something big just went down at the chapel and Hypofiends started appearing!
say:4:1710828203:1.source_cn: 刚才圣古堂那边似乎出了什么大事，紧接着魔物和深渊裂隙就...

say:5:1710828204:1.text: We've held the nearby civilians back for now, but more of them keep coming. We're barely hanging on!
say:5:1710828204:1.source_cn: 我们虽然暂时护住了周边的民众，但魔物越来越多，所以有点...

say:6:1710828205:1.text: We can't hold here. It's open ground. If we get surrounded, we're dead.
say:6:1710828205:1.source_cn: 不能原地死守，这里地形开阔，一旦被围攻就是死路一条。

say:7:1710828206:1.text: We need to evacuate. Where's the nearest safe zone?
say:7:1710828206:1.source_cn: 必须立刻转移，现在的安全区在哪里？

say:8:1710828207:1.text: The theater is secure. Court mages there are providing support.
say:8:1710828207:1.source_cn: 有同僚发信号说露天剧场那边暂时安全，还有宫廷魔法师在那...

say:9:1710828208:1.text: But Captain... the route there is crawling with monsters. Forcing through with all these civilians will be risky!
say:9:1710828208:1.source_cn: 可是队长……通往剧场的路全是魔物，带着这么多民众硬闯，...

say:10:1710828209:1.text: It's our only option. We move now.
say:10:1710828209:1.source_cn: 没有别的选择，得立刻转移！

say:11:1710828210:1.text: On my command, prepare to break through!
say:11:1710828210:1.source_cn: 听我命令！全员准备突围！

say:12:1710828211:1.text: I'll lead the front, civilians in the center.
say:12:1710828211:1.source_cn: 我在最前方开路，民众们跟在中间。

say:13:1710828212:1.text: Martin, you cover the rear. Don't let a single Hypofiend slip past!
say:13:1710828212:1.source_cn: 马丁，你带人负责殿后。绝不能让任何一只魔物靠近民众！

say:1:1710828901:1.text: Captain! Thank Dura, we got them through!
say:1:1710828901:1.source_cn: 队长！感谢艾雅，您把大家都带出来了！

say:2:1710828902:1.text: We've fortified the theater perimeter. The monsters won't break through anytime soon.
say:2:1710828902:1.source_cn: 我们在剧场附近设置了路障，魔物一时半会儿攻不上来。

say:3:1710828903:1.source_cn: 很好。受伤的民众记得安排治疗。

say:4:1710828904:1.source_cn: 请您放心。但是……队长，还有一个紧急情况——

say:5:1710828905:1.source_cn: 刚刚收到求救信号，在广场西南侧和圣古堂前的桥上，还有两...

say:6:1710828906:1.text: Two groups are trapped—southwest of the plaza, and on the bridge before the Hall of Ancients.
say:6:1710828906:1.source_cn: 我们主要的兵力现在都集中在这里维持防线，要是分兵去救的...

say:7:1710828907:1.text: Most forces are holding here. If we split to rescue them...
say:7:1710828907:1.source_cn: 这里的防线不能动。如果分散兵力，这里的民众也会失去保护。

say:8:1710828908:1.text: The line holds here. If it breaks, these civilians are exposed. I'll retrieve both groups myself.
say:8:1710828908:1.source_cn: 广场南侧和圣古堂前的桥上，那两处的民众，我去带他们回来！

say:11:1710828910:1.text: That's an order. Hold this position. I'll return shortly!
say:11:1710828910:1.source_cn: 执行命令，你们守好这里！我去去就回。

say:0:1710829001:0.text: Time to move. People are waiting for me.
say:0:1710829001:0.source_cn: 现在就得出发营救民众了！

say:0:1710829701:0.source_cn: 还有一批民众……得立刻出发了。

say:2:1710830001:1.text: That maneuver just now... I gave no command, but you understood.
say:2:1710830001:1.source_cn: 刚才一瞬间的侧身位配合，我并没有下达指令，但你却理解了。

say:3:1710830002:1.text: Because I knew you'd block the strike and create an opening for me.
say:3:1710830002:1.source_cn: 因为我知道，您一定能挡下那一击，并为我制造出反击的空隙。

say:4:1710830003:1.text: I didn't need to hesitate, I only needed to take the shot.
say:4:1710830003:1.source_cn: 我不需要犹豫，只需要把箭射出去。

say:5:1710830004:0.text: ... All this time, I focused on keeping the danger away from you, keeping you safely behind me.
say:5:1710830004:0.source_cn: ……一直以来，我只想着如何把盾立得更稳，把你严严实实地...

say:6:1710830005:1.text: I forgot that even the strongest defense requires offense.
say:6:1710830005:1.source_cn: 却忘了，最好的防守也需要进攻来配合。

say:7:1710830006:1.text: I've grown, Commander. Just as you're the shield of the empire, I wish to be the arrow this empire fires.
say:7:1710830006:1.source_cn: 我已经长大了，司令。 就像您是耀光的盾，我也想成为能为...

say:8:1710830007:1.text: A shield shouldn't exist only to block. It should become the archer's surest cover.
say:8:1710830007:1.source_cn: 盾牌不应该只用来阻挡攻击，而应该成为弓手最坚实的掩体。

say:9:1710830008:1.text: You protected me. Now... let me stand beside you.
say:9:1710830008:1.source_cn: 以前是您守护我，现在……请让我也与您并肩而战。

say:10:1710830009:1.text: ... I can trust you, Captain Gwyneth.
say:10:1710830009:1.source_cn: ……我想，我可以把后背交给你了，格温妮丝队长。

narration:11:1710830010:1.text: No longer father and daughter, but commander and captain.

narration:12:1710830011:1.text: The distance born of overprotection melts away in the fading light of that arrow...

narration:13:1710830012:1.text: And father and daughter reconcile amid the embers of war.

say:1:1710830501:1.text: Captain! You're back! Here, have some water.
say:1:1710830501:1.source_cn: 队长！您回来了！快，这边有水。

say:2:1710830502:1.text: You've been fighting nonstop. Please, rest!
say:2:1710830502:1.source_cn: 您已经连续战斗太久了，必须马上休息一下！

say:3:1710830503:1.text: Yes, Captain. Let us handle the rest—
say:3:1710830503:1.source_cn: 是啊，队长。剩下的交给属下吧，您——

say:5:1710830504:1.text: Captain Gwyneth! Um... We're here to help!
say:5:1710830504:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝队长！那个……我们来支援了！

say:6:1710830505:1.text: Remember me? Dali, a court mage.
say:6:1710830505:1.source_cn: 您还记得我吗？我是宫廷法师达利。

say:7:1710830506:1.text: Of course. Your intel helped us greatly.
say:7:1710830506:1.source_cn: 当然，您提供的线索帮助了我。

say:8:1710830507:1.text: Heh, glad to hear it! This is my partner, Diza.
say:8:1710830507:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，那就好。哦，对，这位是我的搭档迪兹

say:10:1710830508:1.source_cn: 向您致敬，格温妮丝队长。

say:12:1710830510:1.source_cn: 您好，我有一个提议——依照目前的局势，仅靠物理防线很难...

say:13:1710830511:1.text: We'd like to deploy a high-grade magic barrier over the theater district.
say:13:1710830511:1.source_cn: 不知能否在剧场区域张开保护性极强的魔导屏障？

say:14:1710830512:1.text: Yes, yes! Breaking through will be extremely difficult, even for those Hypofiends!
say:14:1710830512:1.source_cn: 对对对！那里面绝对安全！魔物很难越过去！

say:17:1710830514:1.text: Martin, Gareswell, gather the civilians at the center of the area. Assist the mages in raising the barrier.
say:17:1710830514:1.source_cn: 马丁，加雷斯，立刻组织民众向剧场中心集合，配合两位魔法...

say:1:1710830701:1.text: The barrier's holding! Diza, that was brilliant.
say:1:1710830701:1.source_cn: 屏障生效了！迪兹，你也太厉害了！

say:2:1710830702:1.text: Don't celebrate yet. The barrier can defend us, but it can't attack the monsters.
say:2:1710830702:1.source_cn: 别高兴得太早。屏障只能防御，不能攻击魔物。

say:3:1710830703:1.text: If we want to ease the pressure on the Royal Guard, we'll have to go on the offensive.
say:3:1710830703:1.source_cn: 必须想办法主动出击，减轻守备军的压力。

say:4:1710830704:1.text: You mean... the two of us?
say:4:1710830704:1.source_cn: 啊？主动出击？我们两个吗？

say:6:1710830705:1.text: Captain Gwyneth, I have another proposal.
say:6:1710830705:1.source_cn: ……格温妮丝队长，关于这点我还有一个提议。

say:8:1710830707:1.text: When Savannah was first built, <style="highlight">defensive golems</style> were installed at key locations across the city in preparation for war.
say:8:1710830707:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳在建城之初，为了应对战争，在城市的几个关键节点设...

say:9:1710830708:1.text: Golems? You mean those statues in the plaza? I thought those were decorative.
say:9:1710830708:1.source_cn: 魔像？你是说广场上的那些石像？那不是装饰品吗？

say:10:1710830709:1.text: ... When we're done here, you are rereading "The History of Urban Magical Defense" from cover to cover.
say:10:1710830709:1.source_cn: ……回去之后我一定要让你重修《城市魔法防御史》！

say:11:1710830710:1.text: They're ancient magical weapons. Once awakened, they'll automatically seek and destroy any Hypofiends in the vicinity.
say:11:1710830710:1.source_cn: 其实那些是古老的魔法兵器，一旦唤醒，它们就会自动索敌并...

say:12:1710830711:1.source_cn: 不过这种魔像有一些弊端……

say:14:1710830713:1.text: Their mana cores overheat. After a period of time, they shut down and enter a cooling state.
say:14:1710830713:1.source_cn: 它们的魔力驱动装置容易过热，运作一段时间后，会自动停止...

say:15:1710830714:1.text: When that happens, someone needs to manually reset the switch beside each golem to force it back online.
say:15:1710830714:1.source_cn: 到时候，需要有人手动再开启魔像旁的开关，再次强制唤醒，...

say:17:1710830715:1.text: You're saying we'd have to run out there and reset them while monsters are swarming? That's suicide!
say:17:1710830715:1.source_cn: 在魔物攻击的情况下，跑去再开启开关吗？那也太危险了。

say:18:1710830716:1.text: That's not all. To awaken them the first time, Dali and I must perform the activation ritual on site.
say:18:1710830716:1.source_cn: 不仅如此。初次唤醒它们，更需要我和达利在现场进行魔法激活。

say:19:1710830717:1.text: During the process, we cannot move, or defend ourselves.
say:19:1710830717:1.source_cn: 在这个过程中，我们完全无法移动，也没办法保护自己。

say:20:1710830718:1.source_cn: 明白了。我来护送你们去。

say:21:1710830719:1.text: I'll guard you during the activation and handle the resets afterward.
say:21:1710830719:1.source_cn: 无论是激活时的护卫，还是后续的重启工作，都交给我。

say:22:1710830720:1.text: No, Captain! You've already pushed yourself past your limits! Let us take this one!
say:22:1710830720:1.source_cn: 不行！队长！您已经透支了！这种任务让我们去就行！

say:24:1710830721:1.text: Yeah! We'll guard the mages with our lives if we have to!
say:24:1710830721:1.source_cn: 对！我们哪怕拼上性命，也会保护好两位魔法师大人的！

say:25:1710830722:1.text: Request denied. The area is overrun. You'd need to hold position for extended periods and operate the switches in the middle of combat.
say:25:1710830722:1.source_cn: 驳回。那里全是魔物，而且需要长时间坚守原地，甚至还要在...

say:26:1710830723:1.text: You're tired and your equipment is worn down. You wouldn't survive that kind of sustained assault.
say:26:1710830723:1.source_cn: 那种烈度的围攻，凭你们现在的装备和体力，根本守不住。

say:28:1710830725:1.text: No arguments. It's dangerous. That's precisely why I'm going.
say:28:1710830725:1.source_cn: 没有可是。这很危险，正因为危险，所以我才必须亲自去。

say:29:1710830726:1.text: Listen carefully. The barrier's up, but the civilians still need reassurance. Hold this position. That's an order.
say:29:1710830726:1.source_cn: 听着，屏障虽然建立了，但民众还需要人安抚。守好这里，这...

say:32:1710830728:1.text: Mages, prepare to move. I'll clear us a path.
say:32:1710830728:1.source_cn: 二位魔法师，准备出发吧。我会为你们开辟出一条路来。

say:0:1710830801:0.source_cn: 魔像在那里，格温妮丝队长。

say:1:1710830802:0.text: I see it. Stay close, I'll protect you.
say:1:1710830802:0.source_cn: 好，跟在我身后，我保护你们。

say:0:1710830901:0.text: Most of the golems are on the upper level, so we need to jump over to activate them.
say:0:1710830901:0.source_cn: 很多魔像都在建筑上层，所以我们得跳过去开启了。

say:1:1710830902:0.text: That's not a problem! We can use the mechanism to get there!
say:1:1710830902:0.source_cn: 没问题，我们可以使用机关跳过去！

narration:0:1710831001:1.text: You and Rolan stand before the Hall of Ancients, facing the final wave of monsters.
narration:0:1710831001:1.male: You and Rolan stand before the Hall of Ancients, facing the final wave of monsters.
narration:0:1710831001:1.female: You and Rolan stand before the Hall of Ancients, facing the final wave of monsters.

narration:1:1710831002:1.text: Each swing of Rolan's divine blade erupts in radiant light, while your magic eliminates the monsters attempting to flank you.
narration:1:1710831002:1.male: Each swing of Rolan's divine blade erupts in radiant light, while your magic eliminates the monsters attempting to flank you.
narration:1:1710831002:1.female: Each swing of Rolan's divine blade erupts in radiant light, while your magic eliminates the monsters attempting to flank you.

narration:2:1710831003:1.text: As the last monster turns to ash, the chapel finally falls quiet...

say:0:1710831101:0.text: That one needs activation as well.

say:0:1710831201:0.text: All golems are active! They can assist in clearing the plaza!
say:0:1710831201:0.source_cn: 魔像都已经激活了！可以协助消灭广场的魔物了！

say:1:1710831202:0.text: Finally. Let's go back to the barrier.
say:1:1710831202:0.source_cn: 太好了，那我们先回到屏障附近吧。

say:2:1710831501:1.text: Captain! The outpost reports a massive creature charging toward the theater!
say:2:1710831501:1.source_cn: 队长！前哨发来信号！有个巨大的魔物正朝剧场冲过来！

say:3:1710831502:1.source_cn: 绝不能让这种魔物靠近！

say:4:1710831503:1.text: Martin, Gareswell, hold this position. Coordinate with the mages and secure the barrier.
say:4:1710831503:1.source_cn: 马丁，加雷斯！听令！你们带人守在这里，配合魔法师清理周...

say:5:1710831504:1.text: I'll intercept the monster before it reaches the theater.
say:5:1710831504:1.source_cn: 我去前方截击那个巨大的魔物，在它靠近剧场之前，我会亲手...

narration:0:1710831601:1.text: After some time, you activate all the golems in the plaza.
narration:0:1710831601:1.male: After some time, you activate all the golems in the plaza.
narration:0:1710831601:1.female: After some time, you activate all the golems in the plaza.

say:4:1710832002:1.text: Magister Merlin, I can assist now.
say:4:1710832002:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我现在已经可以做到这些了。
say:4:1710832002:1.male: Magister Merlin, I can assist now.
say:4:1710832002:1.female: Magister Merlin, I can assist now.

say:7:1710832004:0.source_cn: 除此之外，那个亵渎者，迪尔格雷，他逃脱了。

choice_prompt:8:1710832004.source_cn: 除此之外，那个亵渎者，迪尔格雷，他逃脱了。

say:9:1710832005:0.text: Whatever he's planning, it won't be good.
say:9:1710832005:0.source_cn: 他一定在谋划着更险恶的事情。我们得尽快找到他。
say:9:1710832005:0.male: Whatever he's planning, it won't be good.
say:9:1710832005:0.female: Whatever he's planning, it won't be good.

choice_prompt:10:1710832005.male: Whatever he's planning, it won't be good.
choice_prompt:10:1710832005.female: Whatever he's planning, it won't be good.

say:11:1710832006:0.text: Just as you begin tracing Cyran's magical signature, a bloodied guard rushes over.
say:11:1710832006:0.source_cn: 就在你准备追踪迪尔格雷的魔力时，一个浑身是伤的守备军从...
say:11:1710832006:0.male: Just as you begin tracing Cyran's magical signature, a bloodied guard rushes over.
say:11:1710832006:0.female: Just as you begin tracing Cyran's magical signature, a bloodied guard rushes over.

say:19:1710832012:0.text: The traitor, Cyran! He forced his way in!
say:19:1710832012:0.source_cn: 那个叛徒！迪尔格雷！他、他强行闯入了王宫！

say:20:1710832013:1.source_cn: 他打伤了几十名守备军同僚！

say:21:1710832014:1.text: And he's heading straight for the King's chambers!
say:21:1710832014:1.source_cn: 正朝着国王陛下的寝殿去了！

say:23:1710832015:1.text: Your blood runs cold. You and Rolan both know that the King is weakened right now.
say:23:1710832015:1.source_cn: 你和罗兰的心猛地一沉。你们比谁都清楚——国王正处于生命...
say:23:1710832015:1.male: Your blood runs cold. You and Rolan both know that the King is weakened right now.
say:23:1710832015:1.female: Your blood runs cold. You and Rolan both know that the King is weakened right now.

say:24:1710832016:1.text: And the Queen is exhausted from using her foresight and helping Aurora.
say:24:1710832016:1.source_cn: 而王后，在连续使用了意象预视和协助奥罗菈之后，也已精疲力竭！

say:26:1710832017:1.text: Father! Mother! I have to go!

say:28:1710832018:1.text: Peggy rushes forward, but Rolan steps in front of her.
say:28:1710832018:1.source_cn: 佩吉几乎是本能地就要向王宫冲去，但被罗兰伸手拦住。

say:29:1710832019:1.text: You both know she cannot return to the palace.
say:29:1710832019:1.source_cn: 你们很清楚，现在情况危急，佩吉绝不能返回王宫！
say:29:1710832019:1.male: You both know she cannot return to the palace.
say:29:1710832019:1.female: You both know she cannot return to the palace.

say:30:1710832020:1.text: You exchange a glance with Rolan and nod.
say:30:1710832020:1.source_cn: 你与罗兰对视一眼，默契地互相点了点头。
say:30:1710832020:1.male: You exchange a glance with Rolan and nod.
say:30:1710832020:1.female: You exchange a glance with Rolan and nod.

say:33:1710832022:0.text: Merlin, return to the palace at once.
say:33:1710832022:0.male: Merlin, return to the palace at once.
say:33:1710832022:0.female: Merlin, return to the palace at once.

say:34:1710832023:1.text: Your magic is unparalleled. Only you can intercept him before he succeeds.
say:34:1710832023:1.source_cn: 你的魔法是最厉害的——只有你能在他得手前穿过防线，拦截住他！
say:34:1710832023:1.male: Your magic is unparalleled. Only you can intercept him before he succeeds.
say:34:1710832023:1.female: Your magic is unparalleled. Only you can intercept him before he succeeds.

say:36:1710832024:1.text: No! I'm going too! They're my parents!
say:36:1710832024:1.source_cn: 不！我也要去！他们是我的父母！

say:38:1710832026:0.text: The rift is the source of this disaster! Cassadee and I must focus entirely on sealing it.
say:38:1710832026:0.source_cn: 裂隙是灾难的源头！我和科丝蒂必须集中力量关闭它！

say:2:1710844002:1.source_cn: 梅林大人。如您所见，在罗兰大帝的协助下……圣古堂的深渊...

say:2:1710844002:1.female: Magister Merlin. As you can see, with King Rolan's aid, the rift has been completely sealed.

say:5:1710844004:1.text: You explain Cyran's final descent into madness.

say:5:1710844004:1.male: You explain Cyran's final descent into madness.
say:5:1710844004:1.female: You explain Cyran's final descent into madness.

say:6:1710844005:1.text: How he sacrificed himself to summon even greater power, only to be consumed by it and dragged into the rift.
say:6:1710844005:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷在最后的疯狂中，不惜献祭自身，试图召唤更强大的...

say:7:1710844006:1.source_cn: 剩下的，只是收拾残局了。

say:8:1710844007:1.text: Cyran's dark magic defiled the spirits of old heroes.

say:12:1710844010:1.text: Clear the remaining monsters and tend to the wounded.

say:15:1710844012:1.text: Cassadee and I will help too!

say:18:1710844014:1.text: Hendrik and Gwyneth move immediately, directing the guards.
say:18:1710844014:1.source_cn: 亨德里克和格温妮丝立刻行动起来，开始指挥守备军进行最后...

say:19:1710844015:1.text: Rolan turns to face you, with Excalibur glowing softly.

say:19:1710844015:1.female: Rolan turns to face you, with Excalibur glowing softly.

say:20:1710844016:1.text: The source is gone, but the taint remains. It must be cleansed.

say:20:1710844016:1.male: The source is gone, but the taint remains. It must be cleansed.
say:20:1710844016:1.female: The source is gone, but the taint remains. It must be cleansed.

say:21:1710844017:1.text: These heroic spirits... they don't deserve this disturbance.
say:21:1710844017:1.source_cn: 这些英灵……不该被如此惊扰。
say:21:1710844017:1.male: These heroic spirits... they don't deserve this disturbance.
say:21:1710844017:1.female: These heroic spirits... they don't deserve this disturbance.

say:22:1710844018:1.text: I need you with me. Together, we will guide these remains back to rest.
say:22:1710844018:1.source_cn: 我需要你和我一起，借助石中剑和你的净化之力，来引导这些...
say:22:1710844018:1.male: I need you with me. Together, we will guide these remains back to rest.
say:22:1710844018:1.female: I need you with me. Together, we will guide these remains back to rest.

choice_prompt:23:1710844018.male: I need you with me. Together, we will guide these remains back to rest.
choice_prompt:23:1710844018.female: I need you with me. Together, we will guide these remains back to rest.

say:24:1710844019:1.source_cn: 这确实是只有你们两人联手才能完成的、最后的善后。
say:24:1710844019:1.male: Only the two of you can complete this final rite.
say:24:1710844019:1.female: Only the two of you can complete this final rite.

choice:4:1:2.text: The King and Queen are safe.
choice:4:1:2.male: The King and Queen are safe.
choice:4:1:2.female: The King and Queen are safe.

say:1:1710846001:1.text: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?
say:1:1710846001:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀——累坏我啦！好久没活动筋骨，一上来就搞这么大的...
say:1:1710846001:1.male: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?
say:1:1710846001:1.female: Whew, I'm exhausted! I haven't stretched these limbs in ages, and the first thing I do is jump into a battle like that?

say:2:1710846002:1.text: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.
say:2:1710846002:1.source_cn: 你看着他这副模样，一时间竟有些恍惚。
say:2:1710846002:1.male: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.
say:2:1710846002:1.female: You watch him. For a moment, you're not sure what to feel.

say:3:1710846003:1.text: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.
say:3:1710846003:1.source_cn: 喂，梅林。活儿干完了。深渊裂隙封了，迪尔格雷给他自己找...
say:3:1710846003:1.male: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.
say:3:1710846003:1.female: Hey, Merlin. Work's done. The rift is sealed, and Cyran picked a dramatic exit. The Empire should be safe for now.

say:4:1710846004:1.text: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.
say:4:1710846004:1.source_cn: 剩下的烂摊子……自有守备军们收拾。
say:4:1710846004:1.male: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.
say:4:1710846004:1.female: The rest of the mess? The Royal Guard can handle it.

say:5:1710846005:1.text: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
say:5:1710846005:1.source_cn: 我就先走一步，找地方补眠去啦！
say:5:1710846005:1.male: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!
say:5:1710846005:1.female: I'm off. Gotta find a spot to catch up on some sleep!

say:7:1710846006:1.female: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.

choice_prompt:8:1710846006.source_cn: 你无法接受这突兀的转变。现在的局势依然危急——马克西姆国王病重，奥利安王子出逃，王室正统岌岌可危。
choice_prompt:8:1710846006.male: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.
choice_prompt:8:1710846006.female: You can't accept this abrupt departure. The situation remains dire. King Maximilian's ill, Prince Orion fled, and the Empire's future remains uncertain.

say:9:1710846007:1.text: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?
say:9:1710846007:1.source_cn: 你终于问出了那个最关键的问题。 是啊，缔造者已经归来，...
say:9:1710846007:1.male: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?
say:9:1710846007:1.female: You finally ask the question that matters most. The founder of the Lightbearer Empire has returned, why doesn't he claim the throne?

say:10:1710846008:1.text: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.
say:10:1710846008:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我是罗兰“大帝”没错，但那已经是两千年前的事了。
say:10:1710846008:1.male: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.
say:10:1710846008:1.female: Look. I was King Rolan, two thousand years ago.

say:11:1710846009:1.text: My era has long since passed.
say:11:1710846009:1.source_cn: 属于罗兰的时代，早就结束了。
say:11:1710846009:1.male: My era has long since passed.
say:11:1710846009:1.female: My era has long since passed.

say:12:1710846010:1.text: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.
say:12:1710846010:1.source_cn: 带领一群流离失所的人，从无到有，在一片荒芜中建立一个新...
say:12:1710846010:1.male: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.
say:12:1710846010:1.female: Leading a band of displaced people, building something from nothing, founding an Empire from wilderness... that's my strength.

say:13:1710846011:1.text: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.
say:13:1710846011:1.source_cn: 但是，统治一个已经运行了两千年的、庞大而复杂的国家，那...
say:13:1710846011:1.male: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.
say:13:1710846011:1.female: But ruling a kingdom that's thrived for two millennia? Mm. That's not my job.

say:14:1710846012:1.text: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.
say:14:1710846012:1.source_cn: 耀光……早就有它自己的运转逻辑了。
say:14:1710846012:1.male: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.
say:14:1710846012:1.female: The Lightbearer Empire has its own order now.

say:15:1710846013:1.text: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.
say:15:1710846013:1.source_cn: 梅林，这个世界上，没有人能当“永恒的国王”。就算是我也不行。
say:15:1710846013:1.male: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.
say:15:1710846013:1.female: Merlin, no one in this world gets to be an eternal king. Not even a very handsome one like me.

say:16:1710846014:1.text: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.
say:16:1710846014:1.source_cn: 马克西姆会醒来，或者佩吉会成长……
say:16:1710846014:1.male: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.
say:16:1710846014:1.female: Maximilian will awaken, or Peggy will grow.

say:17:1710846015:1.text: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.
say:17:1710846015:1.source_cn: 就算他们都不行，这个国家也总会找到自己的办法存续下去。
say:17:1710846015:1.male: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.
say:17:1710846015:1.female: And even if neither happens... this empire will stumble forward on its own two feet.

say:18:1710846016:1.text: The path ahead belongs to them.
say:18:1710846016:1.source_cn: 接下来的路，得他们自己走。
say:18:1710846016:1.male: The path ahead belongs to them.
say:18:1710846016:1.female: The path ahead belongs to them.

say:19:1710846017:1.text: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!
say:19:1710846017:1.source_cn: 好了，大道理讲完了。本狐太累了，再不走只能倒头就睡了！
say:19:1710846017:1.male: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!
say:19:1710846017:1.female: Alright. Enough philosophy. This fox is about to collapse!

narration:21:1710846019:1.text: The little fox's figure vanishes across the plaza, leaving only the echo of his laughter...

choice:8:1:2.text: Why not lead the Empire again?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么不在这时继续统治耀光呢？
choice:8:1:2.male: Why not lead the Empire again?
choice:8:1:2.female: Why not lead the Empire again?

say:0:1710847001:0.text: I should go check on Hendrik.
say:0:1710847001:0.source_cn: 去看看亨德里克他们的状况吧。
say:0:1710847001:0.male: I should go check on Hendrik.
say:0:1710847001:0.female: I should go check on Hendrik.

say:2:1710848002:1.text: Without you, the consequences would have been unthinkable.
say:2:1710848002:1.source_cn: 王宫和圣古堂……如果不是您，后果不堪设想。
say:2:1710848002:1.male: Without you, the consequences would have been unthinkable.
say:2:1710848002:1.female: Without you, the consequences would have been unthinkable.

say:3:1710848003:1.text: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.
say:3:1710848003:1.source_cn: 我谨代表守备军，和赛凡纳的所有民众，感谢您的帮助。
say:3:1710848003:1.male: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.
say:3:1710848003:1.female: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.

choice_prompt:4:1710848003.text: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.
choice_prompt:4:1710848003.source_cn: 我谨代表守备军，和赛凡纳的所有民众，感谢您的帮助。
choice_prompt:4:1710848003.male: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.
choice_prompt:4:1710848003.female: On behalf of the Royal Guard and all the people of Savannah... thank you.

say:5:1710848004:1.text: Reconstruction and the purging of Cyran's remaining allies will fall to the ministries.
say:5:1710848004:1.source_cn: 后续的重建、抚恤，以及对迪尔格雷党羽的清算，行政部和内...
say:5:1710848004:1.male: Reconstruction and the purging of Cyran's remaining allies will fall to the ministries.
say:5:1710848004:1.female: Reconstruction and the purging of Cyran's remaining allies will fall to the ministries.

say:6:1710848005:1.text: The guard's duty here is complete.
say:6:1710848005:1.source_cn: 我们守备军的职责已经完成了。
say:6:1710848005:1.male: The guard's duty here is complete.
say:6:1710848005:1.female: The guard's duty here is complete.

say:10:1710848008:1.text: You performed well today. You commanded decisively, and you were fearless in battle.
say:10:1710848008:1.source_cn: 你今天做得很好。指挥果断，作战勇猛。

say:11:1710848009:1.text: You've grown. The title of First Division Captain suits you.
say:11:1710848009:1.source_cn: 你成长了，第一分队队长的名号，你当之无愧。

say:12:1710848010:1.text: So... set aside thoughts of Ashvale County.
say:12:1710848010:1.source_cn: 所以……别再去想什么灰影郡前线了。

say:14:1710848012:1.text: Remain in Savannah. Your talents are needed here.
say:14:1710848012:1.source_cn: 留在赛凡纳。在这里，你也能继续发挥自己的长处。

say:15:1710848013:1.text: Needed? To stay the so-called "First Division mascot"? Father... Commander! I need real combat!
say:15:1710848013:1.source_cn: 发挥长处？继续当那个挂名的“第一分队”吉祥物吗？ 父…...

say:17:1710848015:1.text: The core of the capital's defense.
say:17:1710848015:1.source_cn: 是真正承担起守备军的核心职责。

say:18:1710848016:1.text: Today exposed our weaknesses. We must rebuild from the ground up.
say:18:1710848016:1.source_cn: 今日一事暴露了王都防务的空虚，守备军需要彻底重整。

say:19:1710848017:1.text: I want you to help me.
say:19:1710848017:1.source_cn: 我要你留下来，帮我。但是……

say:20:1710848018:1.source_cn: 这可不是什么轻松的差事。你不要嫌苦。

say:22:1710848020:1.text: Fine. I'll think about it. Get me a formal appointment first!
say:22:1710848020:1.source_cn: 我考虑考虑！你先给我正式的任命再说！

say:23:1710848021:1.text: I will petition Her Majesty at once.
say:23:1710848021:1.source_cn: 我会立刻向王后陛下请命的。

say:26:1710848023:1.text: I'll make sure Mother agrees! Gwyneth was truly amazing today!
say:26:1710848023:1.source_cn: 我一定会让母后同意的！格温妮丝今天这么厉害，她留下是理...

say:28:1710848024:1.text: I'll go to the palace shortly to report to the Queen.
say:28:1710848024:1.source_cn: 我稍后要去王宫，向王后陛下汇报此次战役的全部经过。

say:29:1710848025:1.text: You... just wait for your formal position.
say:29:1710848025:1.source_cn: 你……就等着之后的正式就任吧。

say:30:1710848026:1.text: Don't worry. I won't be late!
say:30:1710848026:1.source_cn: 放心，我肯定不会迟到的！

narration:31:1710848027:1.text: The shadow that loomed over the capital finally lifts. Sunlight returns to the battered plaza.

narration:32:1710848028:1.text: With this victory, the Empire's path to rebuilding has only just begun...

choice:4:1:2.text: I was just doing my part.
choice:4:1:2.male: I was just doing my part.
choice:4:1:2.female: I was just doing my part.

subtitle:1:1710815002:.text: He's returned! And he's brought Princess Peggy back!
subtitle:1:1710815002:.source_cn: 王子带着佩吉公主回来了！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710820002:.source_cn: 看着真正的末日……到来吧！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831701:.text: Dali, go right! I'll go left!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831701:.male: Dali, go right! I'll go left!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831701:.female: Dali, go right! I'll go left!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831703:.text: This should take some pressure off the guards!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831703:.source_cn: 这下可以减轻守备军压力了！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831703:.male: This should take some pressure off the guards!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831703:.female: This should take some pressure off the guards!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831301:.text: Report! More Hypofiends emerging from the north!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831301:.source_cn: 报告队长！突然又出现好多魔物！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831302:.text: Drive them back! Protect the barrier!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710831302:.source_cn: 击退魔物！保护魔导屏障！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710845005:.text: It simply returned to its rightful place.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710845005:.male: It simply returned to its rightful place.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710845005:.female: It simply returned to its rightful place.

subtitle:1:1711091001:.text: Draw the sword! Draw the sword!

subtitle:1:1711091002:.source_cn: 奥利安王子！奥利安王子！

subtitle:1:1711091009:.text: What are you trying to do now?!
subtitle:1:1711091009:.male: What are you trying to do now?!
subtitle:1:1711091009:.female: What are you trying to do now?!

subtitle:1:1711093001:.text: Heh... then allow me to present a more appropriate tribute.
subtitle:1:1711093001:.source_cn: 呵……那就让我献上最相称的礼赞——

subtitle:1:1711093006:.text: To whom you swore eternal loyalty...
subtitle:1:1711093006:.source_cn: 向你们誓死效忠的君王

subtitle:1:1711094001:.text: The monsters are no longer a threat.
subtitle:1:1711094001:.source_cn: 魔物现在已经不是威胁了

subtitle:1:1711094002:.text: We must restore order at once.
subtitle:1:1711094002:.source_cn: 我们应该尽快恢复这里的秩序

subtitle:1:1711094003:.text: Ensure the safety of the people.

subtitle:1:1711095002:.text: I will not lose to you again!
subtitle:1:1711095002:.male: I will not lose to you again!
subtitle:1:1711095002:.female: I will not lose to you again!

subtitle:1:1711095006:.text: Let us sink into the abyss together!
subtitle:1:1711095006:.male: Let us sink into the abyss together!
subtitle:1:1711095006:.female: Let us sink into the abyss together!

subtitle:1:1711096002:.text: Isn't this what you wanted? To stop all this?
subtitle:1:1711096002:.source_cn: 你不是想阻止这一切吗？
subtitle:1:1711096002:.male: Isn't this what you wanted? To stop all this?
subtitle:1:1711096002:.female: Isn't this what you wanted? To stop all this?

subtitle:1:1711096008:.text: I'll be the first to welcome you!
subtitle:1:1711096008:.male: I'll be the first to welcome you!
subtitle:1:1711096008:.female: I'll be the first to welcome you!

say:0:1710832101:0.text: The golems along the path seem to have overheated and stopped attacking. I'll have to reactivate them first.
say:0:1710832101:0.source_cn: 沿途的魔像好像过热停止攻击了，我必须先行启动他们。
say:0:1710832101:0.source_graph_cn: 沿途的魔像好像过热停止攻击了，我必须先行启动他们。
